desc:
GAMEPLAY
🛍️ Steal items from the mall 
⭐ Gain XP for every steal and completing tasks
🚤 Level up your Mall Pass for awesome rewards
👮 Avoid the guards and steal from other players!
🔥 Check out the changing HOT ITEMS for bonus rewards!
⬆️ Use Kash to upgrade your character
🔮 Collect and equip unique customization options to your getaway car.
🥇 Boost your rewards and top the leaderboards with the best loadout!
😈 Be the best thief and become MOST WANTED

💷 Use the code 'Welcome' in the game for bonus Kash.
 
Please note!
🚨 It’s all just fun and chaos, stealing in real life is never okay!
